reason: Entries to the changed line: put_on (fall-through after BVS) and put_on.going_on (JSR from render.6502:543); no label+N references. In SKY_MODE builds (1 or 2) the next instruction is JSR sky_room, whose first instruction is JSR test, which begins LDX back, so X is rewritten before any read; compact is only called after test (X = back) and its start reads boff/Y, not X. Every exit of sky_room reaches render.6502 with X = back (test's LDX; compact's path re-runs test). After it: BCS masked -> LDX back; sky_put_on starts LDX dm_slot (SKY_MODE=1) or is CLC/RTS (SKY_MODE=2) -> BCC masked -> LDX back; the C-set path does LDX dm_slot before record_live. N/Z from the dropped LDX are overwritten by test's LDA/CMP/SBC before use; A, Y, C, V, memory unchanged; stack unchanged. The interrupt cannot observe X of the interrupted code (it saves/restores registers). SKY_MODE = 0 builds keep the LDX (ELSE path reads arena_top_lo,X). Equivalent on every path; layout shift (2 bytes) is the machine lens's/gate's concern.
